mapper.select: /* ExcelJobMapper.selectByJobId */ SELECT j.job_id AS jobId , j.biz_nm AS bizNm , j.file_name AS fileName , j.worker AS worker , j.server_id AS serverId , j.status AS status , j.processed_rows AS processedRows , j.total_rows AS totalRows , j.file_path AS filePath , j.params_json AS paramsJson , j.columns_json AS columnsJson , j.template_id AS templateId , j.error_msg AS errorMsg , j.cancel_yn AS cancelYn , j.created_at AS createdAt , j.started_at AS startedAt , j.completed_at AS completedAt FROM ha_excel_job j WHERE j.job_id = #{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* ExcelJobMapper.selectOldestPending */ SELECT j.job_id AS jobId , j.biz_nm AS bizNm , j.file_name AS fileName , j.worker AS worker , j.server_id AS serverId , j.status AS status , j.processed_rows AS processedRows , j.total_rows AS totalRows , j.file_path AS filePath , j.params_json AS paramsJson , j.columns_json AS columnsJson , j.template_id AS templateId , j.error_msg AS errorMsg , j.cancel_yn AS cancelYn , j.created_at AS createdAt , j.started_at AS startedAt , j.completed_at AS completedAt FROM ha_excel_job j WHERE j.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY j.created_at ASC LIMIT 1

/* ExcelJobMapper.selectAllPendingJobs */ SELECT j.job_id AS jobId , j.biz_nm AS bizNm , j.file_name AS fileName , j.worker AS worker , j.server_id AS serverId , j.status AS status , j.processed_rows AS processedRows , j.total_rows AS totalRows , j.file_path AS filePath , j.params_json AS paramsJson , j.columns_json AS columnsJson , j.template_id AS templateId , j.error_msg AS errorMsg , j.cancel_yn AS cancelYn , j.created_at AS createdAt , j.started_at AS startedAt , j.completed_at AS completedAt FROM ha_excel_job j WHERE j.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY j.created_at ASC

/* ExcelJobMapper.selectOrphanedPendingJobs */ SELECT j.job_id AS jobId , j.biz_nm AS bizNm , j.file_name AS fileName , j.worker AS worker , j.server_id AS serverId , j.status AS status , j.processed_rows AS processedRows , j.total_rows AS totalRows , j.file_path AS filePath , j.params_json AS paramsJson , j.columns_json AS columnsJson , j.template_id AS templateId , j.error_msg AS errorMsg , j.cancel_yn AS cancelYn , j.created_at AS createdAt , j.started_at AS startedAt , j.completed_at AS completedAt FROM ha_excel_job j WHERE j.status = 'PENDING' AND j.created_at < #{cutoffMs, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY j.created_at ASC
